    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        long kl = sc.nextLong();
        if (kl >= n) {
            System.out.println(0);
            sc.close();
            return;
        }
        int k = (int) kl;
        fact = new int[n + 1];

            if (ans >= fmod) ans -= fmod;

        int res = (int)((long)fmul(fmul(ans, fact[n]), fmul(ifact[k], ifact[n - k])) % fmod);
        if (k == 0) {
            System.out.println(res);
        } else {
            System.out.println(fmul(res, 2));
        }
        sc.close();

    static int ifact(int x) {

            return ifact[x];
        } else {
            return ifact[x] = fpow(fact[x], fmod - 2);
        }

            base = fmul(base, base);
